aboutGame.title: What is A Game About Needle In A Haystack?
paragraphs: A Game About Needle In A Haystack is a first-person casual simulation from Little Field Studios. Released on Steam for PC on October 16, 2026, it turns the familiar saying into a hands-on search through a giant haystack.

You dig up hay, fill your bag, and sell the collected hay for cash. That money buys tools and upgrades such as the pitchfork, dynamite, and vacuum, giving you new ways to clear the pile while you work toward the hidden needle.

items.question: What is A Game About Needle In A Haystack?
items.answer: A Game About Needle In A Haystack is a first-person casual simulation from Little Field Studios. You dig through a giant haystack, collect and sell hay, buy tools and upgrades, and keep searching until you find the hidden needle.

items.question: How do you play A Game About Needle In A Haystack?
items.answer: In A Game About Needle In A Haystack, you search the haystack in organized sections, dig up hay, and carry what you collect to the cow to sell. The money pays for better tools and upgrades, which help you clear more hay and continue the hunt.

items.question: What tools are available in A Game About Needle In A Haystack?
items.answer: In A Game About Needle In A Haystack, the pitchfork, dynamite, and vacuum each offer a different way to handle hay. Compare their uses and upgrade the option that fits your current search route and budget.

items.question: How do you make money in A Game About Needle In A Haystack?
items.answer: In A Game About Needle In A Haystack, collect hay until your bag is full, sell the load at the cow, then reinvest the cash in tools and upgrades. A steady collect-sell-upgrade loop is the most reliable way to make progress.

items.question: Is A Game About Needle In A Haystack single-player?
items.answer: Yes. A Game About Needle In A Haystack is listed as a single-player game on Steam, so the search loop is built around one player exploring the haystack at their own pace.
